Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment is Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.). This is a contractual position offered by the institute.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) position. This is a single opening announced by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) role ranges from Rs. 29,290 to Rs. 38,220 per month, plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma (3-year duration) in an appropriate discipline with two years of relevant work experience, or an ITI (2-year duration) in a relevant field with eight years of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the location of the IIT Delhi campus?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110016.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.
